name: The Far Rings
source:
At the tail end of a galactic war, Athena, a humanitarian medic, finds herself alone on a transport ship with a dashing captain she might remember from a distant past and an alien war criminal who doesn't quite look the part. In three days, their ship will reach the planet she used to call home, but perhaps Athena must choose a new future, and may even find love, from the struggles she and her two companions will encounter.

[From [url=https://heiden.itch.io/the-far-rings]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
银河战争接近尾声时，人道主义医护人员雅典娜发现自己独自待在运输船上，身旁是一名英俊的船长——她似乎记得他来自遥远的过去——以及一名外表完全不像战犯的外星战犯。三天后，飞船将抵达她曾经称作故乡的星球；但在与两名同伴共同面对困难的过程中，雅典娜或许必须选择新的未来，甚至可能找到爱情。

[来源：[url=https://heiden.itch.io/the-far-rings]itch.io[/url]]
